title: Bram and the Hollow Revisited
premise: Ivo Underhill, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has hidden their gift for seven years in the city of Corvane, where magic is outlawed and charms are sold as trinkets. When the crown's witch-hunters begin dragging gifted folk to the Hollow—the wound between realms where magic was sealed—Ivo is exposed by a child they once protected and forced to flee with a disgraced huntress who knows too much. Together they seek the buried covenant-stone that could reforge the broken pact between human and hollow-born before the long winter swallows both worlds. In the end, Ivo must choose between reclaiming the power that once corrupted them or surrendering it entirely—and they discover that belonging was never granted by oath, but chosen.
about_author: Sebastian Quintana is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval oaths and land charters before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about people bound by promises they no longer believe in.

chapters.title: The Weight of Small Charms
chapters.summary: Ivo Underhill sells luck-knots in Corvane's night market, hiding their swordspeech behind harmless cantrips. POV: Ivo. A gifted child named Wren recognizes Ivo's true voice during a raid, and crown hunters mark them both. The emotional beat is the ache of self-erasure—seven years of smallness shattered in one moment of instinctive protection.

chapters.title: What the Huntress Carried
chapters.summary: Huntress Maren Voss, ordered to arrest Ivo, defects instead when she learns her own sister died in the Hollow. POV alternates Ivo and Maren as they flee through the salt marshes toward the covenant-stone beneath the old border shrine. The emotional beat is wary trust: two enemies discovering they were both betrayed by the same crown.

chapters.title: The Hollow Remembers
chapters.summary: At the drowned shrine, the covenant-stone demands an oath spoken in a voice the speaker cannot take back. Ivo relives the memory of how their swordspeech once razed a village under a corrupt lord's command. POV: Ivo, with Wren's captured cries echoing through the stone. Climax: Ivo speaks the reforging oath as winter breaks over them, choosing vulnerability over power.

chapters.title: A Voice Worth Keeping
chapters.summary: The covenant holds; the Hollow opens not as a wound but a door, and the long winter recedes. Ivo survives diminished—magic thinned to embers—but returns to Corvane where gifted folk are no longer hunted, and Wren becomes their first student. POV: Ivo. Resolution beat: quiet belonging found not in power restored, but in community freely joined.
